info.title: AlphaMarket Broker Integration API
info.description:
AlphaMarket v2 Broker Integration API. Universal spec for all onboarded brokers.

**Your broker account is scoped by AlphaMarket admins.** Calls, strategies, and webhook events you receive are filtered by:
- `allowed_advisors` — which advisors' content you can see
- `allowed_strategies` — optional fine-grained per-strategy opt-in
- `allowed_segments` — equity vs F&O scoping

If you expect to see a strategy/advisor that isn't appearing in your responses, contact AlphaMarket's integration team — it's a scope configuration, not a bug.

**Webhook brokers** can receive one of two payload formats:
- `v1_flat` (default) — simple `{event, timestamp, data}` shape
- `v1_thealphamarket` — byte-exact match to legacy thealphamarket.com spec

Payload version is configured per-broker on our side. To switch, contact admin.

**Contact:**
- Email (primary): hello@alphamarket.co.in
- Email (escalation): amit@thealphamarket.com
- Phone: +91 90291 29102

Hit-rate, period-wise P&L, best/worst closed calls.

The main endpoint for brokers polling AlphaMarket. Returns all currently-active recommendations visible to this API key, across every strategy of every allowed advisor.

Recommended polling interval: 30-60 seconds. For real-time delivery, register a webhook instead.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key issued by AlphaMarket. Format: `amk_live_<64 hex chars>`.

certificateURl.description: SEBI RIA certificate URL (spelling preserved from legacy contract — note capital U, lowercase l)

Recommendation.description:
A single trading call with full advisor+strategy context.

Either `equityCall` OR `fnoCall` is populated — never both. Equity/Basket strategies populate `equityCall`. Future/Option/Commodity strategies populate `fnoCall` (an array to support multi-leg strategies like iron condor).

**This exact shape is delivered identically via the Pull API `data` field and inside the Webhook Push `data` field — one parser works for both integration modes.**

callId.description: Internal AlphaMarket UUID of the call. Use for idempotency and deduplication.

symbol.description: For F&O, the full contract symbol (e.g. NIFTY26APRFUT)

rational.description: Advisor's rationale. For closed calls, may be TargetAchieved, StoplossTriggered, TrailingSLTriggered, or custom.

equityCall.description: Populated for Equity/Basket strategies. Null for F&O.

fnoCall.description: Populated for Future/Option/Commodity strategies. Array supports multi-leg strategies.

status.description: Delivery status to this broker. SEND = delivered.

legGroupId.description: UUID grouping multiple positions in a multi-leg trade (e.g. spreads, straddles). All legs share the same legGroupId. Null for single-leg positions.

legName.description: Human-readable leg label (e.g. 'Leg 1', 'Bear Put Spread - Long'). Null for single-leg positions.

isMultiLeg.description: True if this position is part of a multi-leg trade.

FnoCall.description: F&O recommendation leg. Futures, options, or commodity derivatives.

isStoppLossAbsolute.description: Whether stopLoss is absolute (Y) or percentage (N)

CallSearchRequest.description: All fields optional; omit to disable that filter.

WebhookPayload.description: Webhook payload shape. Which variant you receive is determined by your broker's webhook_payload_version setting (configured by AlphaMarket admin).

BrokerScope.description: Describes the scoping filters admins have configured for your broker account. Returned from GET /health as metadata so you can see your effective scope.

allowed_advisors.description: Advisor UUIDs you're granted access to. null = all advisors allowed.

allowed_strategies.description: Strategy UUIDs you can access. null = no strategy-level restriction.

allowed_segments.description: Segment codes you receive. null = all segments.

webhook_payload_version.description: Which webhook payload shape your account receives.

webhook_timeout_ms.description: Max time (ms) we wait for your webhook endpoint to respond before treating as failure.

WebhookHeaders.description: Headers sent on every webhook POST. Verify signature before parsing body.

X-AlphaMarket-Event-Id.description: Stable event ID for idempotency. Same value on retries — use for deduplication.

X-AlphaMarket-Timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when we fired the event. Reject requests older than a few minutes to prevent replay.

X-AlphaMarket-Signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 of raw body using your api_secret. Format: 'sha256=<hex>'. Verify before parsing.

WebhookPayloadV1Flat.description: Default webhook payload shape. Simple, flat JSON.

data.description: Event-specific payload. Shape depends on event type — see Recommendation / EquityCall / FnoCall schemas.

WebhookPayloadV1TheAlphaMarket.description:
Format A payload — byte-exact match to legacy thealphamarket.com webhook spec. Used by brokers migrating from the legacy stack. Contact admin to enable this version for your account.

Note quirks preserved from legacy spec: 'rational' (no 'e'), 'certificateURl' (lowercase l), 'isStoppLossAbsolute' (original typo), ISO timestamps with +00:00 not Z, targetPriceRange/stopLoss/profitGoal as strings not numbers.

certificateURl.description: Advisor SEBI certificate URL. Note: field name has lowercase 'l' at end (legacy quirk preserved).

equityCall.description: Populated for equity events. Null for F&O events.

legId.description: First 5 hex chars of call UUID

rational.description: Field name has no 'e' at end (legacy quirk)

fnoCall.description: Populated for F&O events. Null for equity events.
